_comment: English changelog — keep entries in sync with changelog.json

entries.title: One account, AI on credits — no key needed
entries.body: Sign up with your email and get 20✦ free. You can use AI organizing without pasting an API key, and your balance and usage history live in the header badge and the Credits & Subscription page. Bring your own key and credits are not spent.

entries.title: Sync across devices — extension and web app share data
entries.body: Sign in and your notes, projects and events merge across devices, so a dump from the desktop extension continues on your phone at dumply-app.vercel.app. Edits made on two devices merge per item instead of one overwriting the other, and deletions no longer come back. API keys and Google connections stay on each device.

entries.title: New look — matte mono with themes and accents
entries.body: Backgrounds are now a calm matte monotone (Zinc), with cards, type, spacing and icons all reworked. Pick a theme such as dark or craft, plus one of five accent colours, in Settings. Emoji icons were replaced with stroke icons.

entries.title: Reworked navigation — drawer and a collapsing header
entries.body: The side panel's left rail became a drawer. As you scroll, the greeting and tabs fold into a single top bar, giving the narrow panel noticeably more room. Search and notifications in the header now work.

entries.title: Gmail — important mail into your Inbox
entries.body: Connect Gmail from Settings or onboarding to pull recent important, unread mail into your Inbox and sort it like any other dump. Messages are never pulled twice.

entries.title: Settings and project screens cleaned up
entries.body: Settings is grouped into Profile, AI, Accounts & Sync and Data, with API key entry moved to its own page. Project detail is down to a single progress bar and one line for the period, and the large grey boxes on empty lists are gone. Date and time pickers were replaced too.

entries.title: Tasks added from a project not landing in it
entries.body: Switching between the task and event tabs reset the project and priority, so an item created inside a project only appeared on the dashboard. It now survives the switch. Items already created can be pulled in with Import in the project.

entries.title: Other fixes
entries.body: Fixed the blank gap on days with no events, toasts collapsing into a circle when the message ran long, and grey blocks behind empty states inside cards. Signing out now clears the Google and Gmail connections too.

entries.title: Dumps are now read with the 5W1H principle
entries.body: When organizing a brain dump, Alfredo now also extracts who, when, where, what, how, and why. Events get their people and location filled in automatically, and you can check the 👥 📍 🔧 💡 chips in the inbox rationale line and the detail view. Works without an AI key too, powered by built-in rules.

entries.title: Prompt Library beta is live
entries.body: The Prompt Library — save your go-to prompts and pull them out instantly — is now in beta at prompts.dumply.app. Automatic platform sorting, tags and search, and cross-device sync are free, and connecting a personal Anthropic API key unlocks unlimited AI prompt improvement and generation.

entries.title: Fixed calendar monthly view not loading
entries.body: Fixed an issue where monthly events wouldn't load. Also improved Google sign-in stability for non-store installs.

entries.title: Smoother onboarding
entries.body: Lightened up onboarding so first-time users can finish their first dump within 30 seconds.

entries.title: First release, with Alfredo
entries.body: The first release of the side-panel extension where Alfredo the detective penguin reads your dumps and sorts them with MoSCoW. Supports Claude · OpenAI · Gemini (BYOK).
